# A loop defer f()? captures the error result by reference, so escape
# analysis moves err to the heap. S3 inverts the stderr pins below.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

logos build -gcflags=-m -o $WORK/esc$GOEXE .
stderr 'moved to heap: err'
stderr 'func literal escapes to heap'
exists $WORK/esc$GOEXE

-- go.mod --
module example.com/deferesc

go 1.27

-- main.lgo --
package main

//go:noinline
func closeNil() error { return nil }

func Loop(n int) (err error) {
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		defer closeNil()?
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	if err := Loop(3); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
